name: Omarchy Lab
author: Charles Tao
description: Benchmark your Omarchy machine from the bar: hardware (CPU, memory, disk), AI agent coding, and everyday multitasking with a browser and update load. Tests run only when you pick one, in a terminal you can see and stop. Results can be shared as a GitHub issue. English, 简体中文, 繁體中文 and 日本語.

barWidget.description: Run Omarchy Lab tests, open results, and share them
